title: Keysight Technologies
summary: US test-and-measurement leader supplying quantum control and RF design tools.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Keysight supplies oscilloscopes, signal sources, network analysers and design software, and has built quantum control systems for superconducting and trapped-ion computers. Its instruments are used across the quantum stack, from cryogenic wiring to room-temperature electronics. The company also serves communications, aerospace and semiconductor customers.

Technology Exposure

  • Quantum control systems
  • RF and optical test instruments
  • Design and simulation software

What To Watch

  • Quantum-lab demand
  • Communications capex
  • Competition and pricing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
